title: The universe has a structure
learning_goal: Explain how galaxies form the cosmic web without confusing it with a solid object
subject: astronomy

approved_facts.statement: Galaxies are systems of stars, gas, dust and dark matter held together by gravity.
Galaxies gather into groups and clusters.
On large scales, galaxies trace filaments and sheets around immense relatively empty voids, making a cosmic web.
Gravity pulls matter together and helps this structure develop over time.
The cosmic web is a distribution of matter, not one solid wall or a literal web of strings; the animation is illustrative, not to scale.
